name: Crestwood (United States)
description: White field charged with the city logo, the name CRESTWOOD in black with the two Os formed by green tree canopies.
history: Crestwood is a city in Gravois Township, St. Louis County, Missouri, that is part of the Metropolitan Statistical Area known as Greater St. Louis. The flag was adopted on 23 April 2019 (adopted with a new city logo at the board of aldermen meeting of 23 April 2019, replacing a flag from a 1973 residents' contest won by William Shana, according to Flags of the World citing the South County Times).
